Cloud Platform Intern — Cobalt Data

About Cobalt Data

Cobalt Data builds reliable, human-centered software and analytical platforms used by teams across universities, financial institutions, and distributed engineering organizations. We value clear written communication, careful engineering, and measurable outcomes over buzzwords.

Role Overview: Cloud Platform Intern

As a Cloud Platform Intern at Cobalt Data, you will collaborate with product engineers, data scientists, and operations leads to design, test, and ship production workflows. You will participate in weekly design reviews, write well-documented code and unit tests, monitor service reliability, and help improve internal developer tooling.

Requirements & Qualifications

Currently enrolled undergraduate; must be authorised to work in India. Applications must be received by December 20, 2026.

Core skills for this position include Go, Kubernetes, Linux. Candidates should be comfortable working with version control, structured data, and collaborative code reviews.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and a short note describing a recent technical or analytical project. We review applications carefully and communicate updates through our official careers portal.
